description.value: Mr. Japanese Curry is a compact Vancouver restaurant dedicated to authentic house-made Japanese curry, with a sauce recipe inspired by Harima Foods of Western Japan and built from over 17 spices for a sweet-umami-spicy flavour profile. Diners choose a beef, chicken, or vegan curry base and customize with a wide range of traditional toppings over premium Koshihikari short-grain rice. The menu is notably cyclist-friendly in its breadth, with several fully vegan and vegetarian dishes clearly identified.
